subject: alt-d
title: ALT.D.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram closing R(AS)CM(I)-12. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the phenomenon of "time lag" re-interpretation cannot be allowed to continue unchecked because we all suffer from "incomplete information."' The crossing diagrams how alternative-definitions structurally meet social-reality at the re-interpretation interface: (C)ALT-D (the concept of alternative definitions — the actual working definitions the form would carry if not suppressed) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the receiving cultural reality that western information regulation has shaped). ALT-D sits on the left with the subject-arrow; POL-DY (political dynamics) branches from the main line, and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from POL-DY. SOC-RT sits centrally as partner-axis. PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) branches down from the main line; a *dashed* line runs from PHY-U-P to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) at the lower-left, amplifying some aspect of PHY-U-P. INFO-DS (information dissemination) also branches from PHY-U-P; IDY-G-ACT, TF-SH (transfer shifts) and PRI-INFO (principle information) branch from INFO-DS, PER-TRS (perceived transition) branches from TF-SH by a dashed line, and PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) branches from PRI-INFO.
